verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Incident Workflows are explicitly documented as a condition-based automation engine using 'if-this-then-that' logic that triggers automated actions (e.g., field changes, notifications, reminders) based on incident event conditions like P1/P2 severity. Escalation policies and event orchestration further automate incident-response toil (assignment, deduplication, escalation) without manual intervention. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Incident Workflows specifically (community evidence discusses escalation and paging generally but not the workflow engine), and detailed examples of field-change/reminder automation beyond marketing-style docs.
